args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimsuit
- Quick-dry swim shorts
- Lightweight rash guard
- Quick-dry t-shirt
- Lightweight long-sleeve shirt for cooler evenings
- Lightweight pants or beach cover-ups
- Lightweight rain jacket (Hawaii can have sudden rain)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops for beach
- Water shoes for snorkeling

### Accessories
- Sunglasses
- Sun hat or wide-brimmed hat
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Lip balm with SPF
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach towel
- Umbrella or beach umbrella
- Beach bag
- Travel-sized toiletries bag
- Travel-sized first-aid kit

### Electronics
- Smartphone with charger
- Portable power bank
- Camera or GoPro (optional)
- Waterproof phone case (optional)
- Earbuds or headphones
- Travel adapter

### Other
- Travel documents and passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel journal or notebook
- Travel-sized medication
- Travel-sized laundry detergent (if needed)
- Travel-sized shampoo and conditioner
- Travel-sized toothpaste and toothbrush
- Travel-sized deodorant
- Travel-sized soap
- Travel-sized razor and shaving cream
- Travel-sized makeup and makeup remover
- Travel-sized hair products
- Travel-sized hair ties or clips
- Travel-sized hair dryer (if needed)
- Travel-sized sewing kit
- Travel-sized sewing needle and thread
- Travel-sized measuring tape
- Travel-sized sewing scissors
- Travel-sized sewing pins
- Travel-sized sewing needle and thread
- Travel-sized sewing scissors
- Travel-sized sewing pins
